Q3_internal_symmetry.selector_result: Any internally symmetry-equivariant deterministic selector of a state relabeling must lie in Z(S3), hence can select only identity without symmetry breaking.

Q12_internal_symmetry.selector_result: A symmetry-equivariant selector can at most distinguish identity or the antipodal internal map r^6. Both act on internal localized-state labels, not on subsystem identity.

typed_consequence: Internal symmetry cannot canonically supply a second subsystem-translation direction. Q3 supplies none; Q12's possible central r^6 remains an internal antipodal state map.
